notes.title: Roadmap & Upcoming Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello Explorers,[/p][p]It’s been a while since our last update, and we wanted to share some honest news with you about the state of Wild Planet and where we’re headed next.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/667838d641f6b5052e11139a73085c0c3c689c2a.png"][/img][/p][p]Since the last patch, things have been a bit quieter on our side. The financial situation after losing our publishing partnership hasn’t been ideal, and it limited our ability to push development at full force. Despite this, we’ve kept working in the background and reshaping the project to ensure it stays sustainable while still delivering the core vision we believe in.[/p][p]As part of this rescope, we’ve had to make some tough choices: three biomes that were initially planned are now removed from the roadmap. The final game will feature six biomes in total still plenty of variety and exploration, but with a tighter focus that allows us to polish each one properly.[/p][p]We are also reworking and removing some features that didn’t quite fit, while adding new systems and mechanics that should make the overall gameplay smoother, more rewarding, and fun. Our goal is quality over quantity, and this adjustment will help us reach that.[/p][p]We know news has been sparse lately, and we’re sorry for the silence. We didn’t want to share half-formed promises instead, we’ve been preparing for the next update, which we want to bring with proper new content you can actually play and enjoy.[/p][p]To give you a better picture, here’s what’s coming up:[/p][p][b]A general roadmap of the next phases of development is being polished and will be posted publicly for anyone interested.[/b][/p][p]A few sneak peeks into the upcoming content and systems we’re working on while preparing the next update, we’ve been working on a lot of concept art and prototypes [/p][list][*][p][b]Tier 3 Technology & Benches[/b] – early sketches and WIP models for advanced crafting stations, unlocking new possibilities in late-game progression.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/27aa84c6da888630a7b5a1060522deec25d2a43a.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Base Building Concepts[/b] – experimenting with fresh structures and layouts to give more freedom and creativity when expanding your base.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/cb8d4080b664e31416f967e36d764798de03e9c7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Biome Research & Maps[/b] – refining the identity, resources, and exploration flow of the 6 final biomes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/af2376c29b46c5d4961216eb472359ce64ea2d7c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/a91470514ce59596d112c0c4392c76c5208140a3.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Dungeons[/b] – we’re designing deeper, more atmospheric dungeons with unique challenges, rewards, and lore pieces to uncover.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]These are still in development, but we wanted to share a small glimpse at how the world and its systems are evolving behind the curtain.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and support. Wild Planet is still alive and moving forward just at a slightly different pace than we first envisioned. We can’t wait to show you more very soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned,[/p][p]The Wild Planet Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.5.0 – The Road North, New Enemies, and First NPC Outpost!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey explorers!
We're back with a [b]major update[/b] focused on polishing the starting experience, introducing new features step by step, and laying the groundwork for future expansions of the world of [i]Wild Planet[/i].[/p][p]This patch brings a [b]general overhaul of the starting area[/b], including improved flow, new threats, first passes at localization, and… our very first [b]NPC Outpost![/b] Buckle up [/p][p]here's everything new in 1.3.5.0 👇[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/2a45e79b6b94cf736959dfdc4bd444bc81eb5175.png"][/img][/p][h2]🚧 World & Exploration[/h2][list][*][p]A [b]road system[/b] now connects biomes from [b]south to north[/b], improving exploration and navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the [b]Abandoned Scientific Outpost[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]New buildings[/p][/*][*][p]New enemies[/p][/*][*][p]New loot[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/2bc01e30e6404db7b91f48e27cde63b9895258d5.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]new alien monolith towers[/b] — mysterious structures requiring puzzles or platforming to reach. These will evolve into something bigger in future updates[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/d868be1ab8882a5930c23d1810eac2ae469cc1ee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a [b]Survivor Outpost in the forest[/b] [i](Work in Progress)[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]First pass of NPCs and environmental storytelling[/p][/*][*][p]Will be expanded further in Patch 1.4 with deeper systems and level design.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🤖 New NPCs & Enemies[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/c491058546547d1c38fdd7e56434c1109e08c234.png"][/img]Introduced our [b]first Mecha NPC Camps[/b] with 3 new robots: [b]Camp Bots[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new forest-dwelling creatures: [b]Oculoras[/b], each with [b]three evolution stages[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]talkative NPC[/b] to the Mining Camp — find him and hear his story[/p][/*][*][p]Removed [b]Pippo[/b] from the forest — RIP little guy (for now 👀)[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/6d02e46ee9d270b764d50a85cea93b6bbe9a2c83.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚔️ Weapons & Combat[/h2][list][*][p][b]New melee weapon: Warhammer[/b][/p][list][*][p]Deals [b]AOE damage[/b] and [b]stuns nearby enemies[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted weapon animations:[/p][list][*][p]Changed [b]Rifle & SMG animations[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]weapon feedback[/b] and [b]bullet FX[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New [b]enemy hit reactions[/b] and [b]screenshake[/b] for added impact[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed [b]stamina regeneration[/b] while inside your base[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 UI, Feedback & QOL[/h2][list][*][p][b]First localization pass[/b] is live! The game now supports:[/p][list][*][p]🇫🇷 French[/p][/*][*][p]🇷🇺 Russian[/p][/*][*][p]🇯🇵 Japanese[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved general UI and added better [b]building placement feedback[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated multiple [b]VFX/SFX[/b] across the board for a more immersive feel[/p][/*][*][p]Added subtle [b]FX to trees and resource nodes[/b] for better visual clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Changed [b]respawn timing[/b] and [b]reduced spawn rates[/b] for certain enemies and nodes in the field biome[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Balance & Tweaks[/h2][list][*][p]Removed some [b]Garoo and Mecha spawns[/b] in the field area to reduce early overwhelm[/p][/*][*][p]Removed [b]Scalamar[/b] from the canyon side of the field[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]unique food items[/b] and [b]rare loot[/b] to underground bunker crates[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This update marks a big step toward deeper narrative, exploration, and survival mechanics. Expect more exciting additions soon—including [b]NPC questlines, dynamic events,[/b] and [b]more biome expansions[/b].[/p][p]As always, your feedback is essential — hit us up on Discord or leave a review on Steam. Thank you for supporting [i]Wild Planet[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]— Vlad & Yilmaz[/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: 1.3.0.0 - UI Overhaul first pass + bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Following the last update adding a new area the canyon aswell as the revamp of the desert ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1323060/view/823701034523165408]You can read more here[/url])

UI Overhaul – First Pass[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/a60c510e027e2199198b5c5b73727ed464e9d914.png[/img]

    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/8413e42e4ed30690f7f73aa10c808da815ca1c3a.png[/img]
Workbench UI improved with clearer craft info.

    
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/6714ad0a7e80f09755aa449f34c94f3334b3b5a8.png[/img]

    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/cc23692b9ccb79f53692bb0024c74d01a0ae5257.png[/img]

See you space cowboys !

notes.title: Sands of Renewal - Content Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Wild Planet Early Access 1.2.0.0 - Sands of renewal[/h1]

Greetings, explorers!

We’re back with a massive content update for Wild Planet! Early Access 1.2.0.0 brings a huge overhaul to the Desert Biome, new areas to discover, and a host of improvements to the survival experience. Let’s dive into what’s new!

We’re trying something new this time with a short trailer showcasing the latest update! Check out the Canyon Biome, the revamped Desert, and more.

[previewyoutube=eE120Ak9Q9k;full][/previewyoutube]

Do you like these videos? Should we keep making them? Let us know!

[h2]New Content & Biome Overhaul[/h2]

[h3]Canyon Biome (New!)[/h3]
We’ve added a brand-new Canyon Biome, offering a glimpse of what’s to come. This rugged landscape is located on the edge of the Field Biome and serves as a transition zone for future expansions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/66d2298d5f3a5554b01ac2b7062b446a1c7cbd7a.png[/img]

[h3]Desert Biome Revamp[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Desert Biome has been completely redone from the ground up
[*] New Oasis Area  A lush reprieve in the arid wasteland, full of valuable resources.
[*] New Desert Trees More variety in the environment for better immersion.
[*] New Plasma Field Area  A new area to farm plasma with your drills
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/74bfdfeaf9b0fd080cdfdb4384218c57aabf0ee3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/117e3612438ffd8f697f3a924bfef285f514d686.png[/img]

[h2]Dungeon Overhaul[/h2]
[h3]Crashed Ship Dungeon (Forest)[/h3] A full remake with improved level design, and new loot!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/33a482d6a090d4f7da94f9b3eb8d3439590536ef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/4595a07f37fc54cacff7ef1683bb359948fe0ca6.png[/img]


[h2]Food & Resources[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Food Recipes added to the Kitchenette, offering more buff options.
[*] Mushrooms now spawn in caves, expanding food foraging options.
[*] New Models: Highland Berries & Aloe for better visual distinction.
[*] Cactus now drops Desert Berries and Cactus Flesh, allowing for new food recipes :)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37863626/272380a1d99c67e1560e7bcac8254ec586fde5e1.png[/img]

Creatures & Combat[h2]
[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Creature: Desert Metalon – A fierce new enemy found in the desert biome.
[*] Reduced the number of Blue Mecha in the field to two, rebalancing enemy encounters.
[*] Adjusted Blue Mecha Spawn Locations for a more varied experience.
[*] Removed Young Metalons from the spawn area to improve early-game difficulty.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay & System Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Water System with a more dynamic visual approach.
[*] Fix: Mining helmet flashlight now properly activates.
[*] Changes to Some Recipes for better balance and crafting progression.
[/list]

[h2]
Work in Progress & Upcoming Features[/h2]
While this update brings a ton of new content, we’re also actively working on even bigger additions coming soon!
🔹 Desert Cave Dungeon featuring a Metalon boss and a brand-new Metalon Armor Set. 🔹 Remake of the Field Bunker, adding new challenges and lore. 
🔹 The Tower of the Lost Dungeon in the forest a mysterious new location to explore. 
🔹 Recipe Updates to refine crafting and balance survival mechanics. 
🔹 Building System Update with improved functionality and customization. 
🔹 New Weapons, Tools, and Armors to expand combat and survival strategies.

[h2]Final Notes[/h2]
We appreciate all the feedback from our amazing community as we continue to shape Wild Planet. Keep sharing your discoveries, suggestions, and bug reports. Your support helps us push the game to new heights!

Happy exploring, and watch out for those Metalons!

[b]See you Space Cowboys ! 🚀[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes EA 1.1.3.0
notes.notes:
[b]Fixes & Improvements[/b]

    Fixed: The long-standing issue where non-host players' UI would switch to another storage in co-op has finally been resolved after 2-3 weeks of research. This fix greatly enhances the co-op experience! 🎉
    Fixed: Various terrain seams to improve world continuity.
    Fixed: Navigation issues with Recycler area stairs.
    Fixed: Typos for Workbench craft and Plasma Drill.
    Fixed: Wrong icon for Beard 3 in the player creator menu.

[b]Gameplay & Optimizations[/b]

    Added: Extra grounding checks for Monowheel and Rhino Mount to ensure better terrain stability.
    Changed: Adjusted tooltip appearance timing for antennas and instance portals to improve readability and usability.
    Changed: Terrain streaming optimizations to improve loading/unloading performance, ensuring smoother gameplay and better resource management.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2.0
notes.notes:
🔧 Fixes & Improvements

    Fixed: Tooltips no longer remain stuck when moving items in the inventory or workbench.
    Fixed: Torches can be picked up once placed, as intended.
    Fixed: Collision issues with torches have been resolved.
    Fixed: Improved collision for building stairs to make placement smoother and prevent navigation issues.

🏗️ World Changes

    Removed: The desert compound has been removed from the map.
    Added: A test version of the Recycler can now be found in the forest. Check it out and let us know what you think!

🎨 Visual & Item Changes

    Changed: The icon for Hardened Brick has been updated for better clarity.
    Adjusted: The Rhino Mount drop rate has been changed to better balance the gameplay experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We're committed to improving Wild Planet with every update. As always, join the conversation on our Discord and share your thoughts.

See you on the Wild Planet! 🌍

notes.title: Update from the Wild Planet Team: Thank You for Your Patience
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We want to start by saying how grateful we are for your support and patience with Wild Planet. We know that updates have been slower than usual, and we’re truly sorry for the delay. Unfortunately, both developers on the team have been battling COVID-19 for the past week, which has slowed down our progress. But we’re on the road to recovery and will be back on track as soon as we’re fully healed.

Despite these setbacks, we’ve still been working behind the scenes. Many bugs reported by the community have been addressed, and we’re working hard on the rest. We’re also planning to publish a list of known issues soon to keep you all updated.

As for the game’s future, we’d like to share a general roadmap that outlines our planned features and improvements. While we can’t provide specific release dates just yet, this roadmap will give you an idea of what’s coming next and where we’re focusing our efforts.

We also encourage everyone to continue sharing your suggestions on our Steam forums or Discord. Your feedback is essential to making Wild Planet the best it can be, and we’re considering adding a voting feature in the future so that the community can have a say in prioritizing features and updates.

In exciting news, we’re close to wrapping up debugging for [b]multiplayer co-op[/b]! We expect to have it back in players’ hands very soon, and we can’t wait to see you all exploring together.

Thank you again for your understanding and support during this challenging time. We’re eager to return to our regular schedule and keep improving Wild Planet with your help.

Stay tuned, and thank you for being part of this journey!
Vlad & Yilmaz

notes.title: Wild Planet Update EA 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Wild Planet Early Access Update EA 1.0.1.0[/h1]

Here are the latest improvements and fixes in version EA 1.0.1.0:
[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]

    [list]
[*] Building in the Desert: Resolved the issue with placing structures in desert areas.
[*]     Shadowsteel Recipes: Fixed crafting recipe issues involving shadowsteel.
[*]     Durability Adjustments: Adjusted durability for early weapons to improve balance.
[*]     Tier 2 Buildables: Fixed interaction problems with T2 structures.
[*]     Cave Respawn Rate: Tweaked respawn rates for creatures and resources in caves.
[*]     Buildable Placement: Addressed an issue where certain buildables wouldn’t place properly.
[*]     Wall Windowed Texture: Fixed texture issues with walls featuring windows.
[*]     Crafting & Loot Balancing: General adjustments to crafting recipes and bunker loot tables for smoother progression.
[*]     Food Prices & Kitchenette Boost: Increased sale price and boosted effects of food crafted in the kitchenette to aid survival.
[*]     Double Click Fix for Building Entities: Resolved an issue where double-clicking on building entities could cause unintended interactions.
[*]     Interaction After Looting: Fixed the issue preventing interactions after looting certain creatures.
[*]     Vehicle Logout Fix: Fixed a bug where players logging out while on a vehicle would fall through the map upon reload.
[*]     Unstuck/Respawn Button: Added an "Unstuck/Respawn" button in settings to help players get back to a safe position if they become stuck.
[*] 
[/list]
[b]In Progress:[/b]

  [list]
[*]   Co-Op Fixes: Instancing issues have been resolved, and we're currently addressing a bug affecting interactions with friends' foundations. Once fixed, Co-Op should be ready to make a strong comeback!
[*]     Quest Bug: Investigating and resolving quest progression bugs.
[*]     New Areas: Continued development on the Garoo Cave in the forest and the Silo Bunker in the desert.
[*]     Recycler Monument: A new monument with added exploration and functionality is coming soon.
[/list]

[b]Upcoming:[/b]

Next week, we’ll share a Roadmap with more exciting updates on upcoming features and improvements.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support—see you on Wild Planet!

notes.title: Wild Planet Update: Steam Next Fest, New Features, and Bug Fixes in Demo v5.7
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Wild Planet is taking part in Steam Next Fest, and with it, we're bringing a major update to our demo! Version 5.7.0.0 is live, filled with new features, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements. Whether you’re revisiting or playing for the first time, there’s plenty to explore.

[h1]What's New in v5.7.0.0?[/h1]
•	Co-op Mode: Team up with a friend! Multiplayer co-op is now available, so you can survive and thrive together on Wild Planet.
•	Female Character: We’ve added a new female character to offer more customization options.
•	New Item - Head Torch: Illuminate your nighttime adventures with the newly added Head Torch.
Major Bug Fixes & Improvements
•	Campfire and Furnace Inventory Fix: We’ve fixed the issue where campfire or furnace inventories would incorrectly appear in storage or workbench inventories.
•	Interaction After Looting: The problem with interactions becoming buggy after looting is now fixed for smoother gameplay.
•	Time Sync: Time and weather sync have been fixed, ensuring that solo and co-op sessions are properly synced. However, time is not yet saved and loaded.
•	UI Updates: Various UI improvements make navigating the game smoother and more intuitive.
•	Customization Fixes: Colors in the customization menu now match exactly as chosen, improving the character creation experience.
•	Mobs and Building Collisions: We’ve improved mob interactions with building structures, making these elements more reliable.
•	Cutout Adjustments: We’ve tweaked how cutouts behave with walls and foundations for better building experiences.
•	Performance Optimizations: Small bug fixes and optimizations ensure the game runs more smoothly.

[h1]Known Bugs in Multiplayer[/h1]
While we’ve made great strides in improving the demo, some known bugs remain in multiplayer:
•	Host-Only Features: Currently, only the host can skip night, enter an instance, or interact with the antenna. We're working on resolving this.
•	Building Restrictions: Players cannot build on foundations they do not own in multiplayer. This will be fixed soon.
•	Desync Issues: Occasionally, desync problems may cause teleportation when entering an instance. Please proceed carefully.
•	Farming Responsiveness: Farming actions can sometimes be a bit unresponsive. We’re aware of this and are working on a fix.

For more details on these bugs, join our Discord to stay up-to-date on progress.

[h1][b]Help Us During Steam Next Fest[/b][/h1]
Even if you've already played the demo, participating during Steam Next Fest will greatly help us gather performance data and feedback. Plus, with co-op mode now live and tons of new features and improvements, it’s the perfect time to dive back into Wild Planet.

Thank you for your continued support as we refine the game for early access. We can't wait to see you exploring the planet!

notes.title: Wild Planet Team Announces Early Access Release Amidst Turbulent Year
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=P3tyoVDbobc;full][/previewyoutube]

After a year of navigating through significant challenges and intensive behind-the-scenes efforts, Wild Planet Team is thrilled to announce the early access release of their game on [b]October 23, 2024.[/b] This announcement comes after a period marked by reorganization, changes in game design, and shifting release goals.

[h2]A Rocky Road to Early Access
[/h2]
The past year has been anything but smooth for the Wild Planet Team. The journey began with a substantial investment by publishers, but it soon faced a setback when disagreements led to the loss of those publishers & investment. Despite this, the team was able to secure a small support through state funding and grants, ensuring the continuation of their project.

[h2]Adapting to New Circumstances[/h2]

Given the reduced financing and a downsized team, now consisting of just three dedicated developers , the decision was made to opt for an early access release. This approach allows the team to continue refining and expanding the game with the community's support while securing the necessary resources to move forward.

[h2]What to Expect in Early Access[/h2]

The early access version of the game will feature a vibrant and immersive open world. Players can explore six distinct biomes, covering a large map, filled with multiple dungeons, caves, and dynamic events. The next five months are crucial for further development and polishing, and the team is committed to delivering regular updates and enhancements.

[h2]Community Engagement and Future Plans[/h2]

To maintain transparency and engage with the community, Wild Planet Team will be providing a detailed roadmap and regular development blogs in the coming months. These updates will offer insights into the development process, upcoming features, and improvements.

[h2]Join the Adventure[/h2]

In anticipation of the early access release, a new teaser trailer is now available on the game's Steam page and YouTube channel. Additionally, the team will participate in the [b]Steam Survival Game Festival [/b]starting next week.

[h2]A Heartfelt Thanks[/h2]

The Wild Planet Team extends their deepest gratitude to their supporters and followers. The journey has been challenging, but the unwavering support from the community has been a beacon of hope and motivation. The team is excited to share this milestone and looks forward to the continued journey together.

Stay tuned for more updates and join the adventure on [b]October 23, 2024[/b], as Wild Planet enters its early access phase. Your feedback and support are invaluable as the team strives to create a remarkable gaming experience.

Dear valued community,

We hope this message finds you well. We wanted to take a moment to address the recent challenges we have faced, which unfortunately caused a slowdown in the production of our game, "Wild Planet." We sincerely apologize for the silence and lack of updates during this period. Due to contractual obligations, we were unable to share many details at that time.

However, we are pleased to inform you that negotiations and discussions are ongoing, and we are fully committed to pushing forward with the project. Our dedicated team has been working tirelessly to overcome the hurdles we encountered, and we are excited to announce that we have relocated to a new office, which has provided us with a fresh and positive environment.

We understand that transparency is crucial, and we assure you that we are working diligently to provide you with more updates regarding "Wild Planet" in the near future. We greatly appreciate your patience and continued support throughout this challenging period.
